title: Coverage recovery Wave 02 part 14 — Zerion and Muun current availability
notes: Evidence-only candidate. These first-party sources support current product availability/support review and are not used to infer original launch dates or create lifecycle events.

evidence.title: Download Zerion
evidence.notes: The first-party Zerion download page currently offers the mobile wallet on iOS and Android. This supports current mobile availability review without inferring launch timing.

evidence.title: Muun Terms of use
evidence.notes: Muun's first-party terms state that the only official Muun wallet is the version distributed by Muun through official app stores. This supports continued official product distribution without inferring launch timing.
